high_definition: close >= maximum close across L observations including today; ties count; require a full L observations
primary: ES at its 20-observation closing high AND equal-weight mean of 5/20/50/200-day closing breadth >=80
confirmation: Each breadth closing series at its own same-lookback closing high; require all four series to have full history
recent_confirmation: At least one own closing-high flag on today or previous four observations; require L+4 observations for all four series
definition_audit: Also disclose source-claim comparison using close strictly above the previous 20 closes; do not select whichever looks best
